tag: 試驗結果登錄 · 安全性揭露
body: 小野藥品 ONO-2808 之 Ph2 試驗（NCT05923866）正式結果登錄上線 CT.gov（hasResults=true，登錄日 2026/10/06）。登錄內容僅含安全性與藥動學指標：24 週核心部分完成率隨劑量遞減（安慰劑 19/23、低劑量 18/23、中劑量 17/23、高劑量 16/23 完成），期間共 2 例死亡（中劑量組 1 例、高劑量組 1 例），經試驗研究者評估均與試驗藥物無關；嚴重不良事件（TESAE）例數安慰劑 6、各劑量組 4，其中與藥物相關者僅安慰劑與低劑量各 1 例。此前已收錄之 mUMSARS 療效數據（MSA-P 次族群正面訊號）僅來自公司期中分析與研討會發表，CT.gov 尚未正式登錄療效結果。
note: → 安全性數字與公司先前揭露之 TEAE 比率一致，未見新增警訊；新曝露之死亡例數為 MSA 晚期病人族群試驗常見之背景死亡率範疇，且均經判定與藥物無關，公司與 Deciphera 之樞紐 Ph3（NCT07825402）規劃未見變動。⚠️ 劑量依存之脫落率上升（安慰劑 4/23 未完成 → 高劑量 7/23）可能反映耐受性隨劑量下降，公開登錄未附具體原因，不臆測。

en.body: Formal results for Ono Pharmaceutical's Phase 2 ONO-2808 trial (NCT05923866) were posted to CT.gov (hasResults=true, posted 2026/10/06). The posting covers only safety and pharmacokinetic measures: 24-week core-part completion declined with dose (19/23 placebo, 18/23 low, 17/23 medium, 16/23 high dose completed), with 2 deaths during the period (1 on medium dose, 1 on high dose), both assessed by investigators as unrelated to study drug; serious adverse events (TESAEs) numbered 6 on placebo and 4 in each dose arm, with drug-related TESAEs limited to 1 each on placebo and low dose. The previously recorded mUMSARS efficacy data (a positive signal in the MSA-P subgroup) still come only from the company's interim analysis and conference presentation; CT.gov has not yet posted formal efficacy results.
en.note: → The safety figures are consistent with the TEAE rates the company previously disclosed, with no new red flags; the newly disclosed deaths fall within the background mortality expected in a late-stage MSA trial population and were judged unrelated to drug, and there is no sign of any change to the company's and Deciphera's plans for the pivotal Phase 3 (NCT07825402). ⚠️ The dose-dependent rise in discontinuation (4/23 not completed on placebo versus 7/23 on high dose) may reflect declining tolerability at higher doses, but the public registration gives no specific reason, and none is speculated here.

tag: 試驗登錄更正 · 狀態澄清
body: 本站追蹤資產例行查核發現，Ionis／Biogen 的 α-synuclein 反義寡核苷酸 ION464（BIIB101）於 MSA 之 Ph1「HORIZON」試驗（NCT04165486），其 ClinicalTrials.gov 登錄現狀與本站此前依 2025/02 多家媒體報導所記錄之「Biogen 宣布終止開發」不一致：登錄最後更新於 2026-04-27（狀態驗證日 2026-04），主辦方現單獨列為 Ionis Pharmaceuticals（不再列 Biogen），整體狀態為收案中，估計主要完成日由原 2025-09 延後為 2027-09。Ionis 官方神經科學產品線網頁亦持續將 ION464 列為 MSA 在研項目之一。
note: → ⚠️ 公開來源未見任何官方聲明解釋此一落差的具體原因（例如 Biogen 是否已將權利歸還 Ionis、由其自行接手續行開發等，均無法核實）；2025/02 Biogen 宣布終止開發 ION464／BIIB101 一事確曾經多家媒體報導，本站不撤銷該歷史記錄，僅依登錄現狀同步更新試驗雷達與在研療法全景之狀態欄，並於此註明兩者並存、尚待官方說明。

links.label: Ionis 神經科學產品線頁面 ↗

en.body: A routine check of tracked assets found that the ClinicalTrials.gov registration for Ionis/Biogen's alpha-synuclein antisense oligonucleotide ION464 (BIIB101) in its Phase 1 'HORIZON' MSA trial (NCT04165486) now conflicts with this site's prior record — based on February 2025 press coverage — that "Biogen announced discontinuation." The registration was last updated 2026-04-27 (status verified 2026-04), now lists Ionis Pharmaceuticals alone as sponsor (Biogen no longer appears), shows the overall status as Recruiting, and has pushed estimated primary completion from 2025-09 out to 2027-09. Ionis's own neuroscience pipeline page also continues to list ION464 among its MSA programmes.
en.note: → ⚠️ No public source explains the specific reason for this discrepancy (whether Biogen returned rights to Ionis, which then continued development independently, or some other explanation — all cannot be verified); the 2025/02 reports of Biogen discontinuing ION464/BIIB101 were carried by multiple outlets and this site does not retract that historical record — it simply updates the Trial Radar and Therapy Landscape status fields to match the current registration, and flags here that both facts coexist pending an official clarification.

tag: 主動盤點新收錄 · Ph3 收案中
body: 主動盤點發現一項先前未收錄之樞紐性資產：MSA-01（ubiquinol／還原型輔酶Q10），由東京大學（Jun Mitsui）與Nobelpharma合作開發。其Ph2試驗（UMIN000031771）已於2023年發表於EClinicalMedicine：139人隨機雙盲安慰劑對照，第48週UMSARS Part 2自基線變化最小平方均差 −1.7分（95% CI −3.2至−0.2，p=0.023），達主要指標。延續此結果，Ph3樞紐試驗（NCT07446894）已於2026/02/09啟動收案，估計收案140人、12日本站點，主要完成日估2028/03。此試驗登錄已逾7個月未再更新、未落入CT.gov近期排序前40名之例行掃描窗口，本次透過更廣泛之管線檢索主動發現並補收。
note: → 機轉為輔酶Q10生合成缺陷（COQ2相關）之營養補充路徑，與目前站上以α-synuclein、神經發炎、細胞治療為主之資產機轉互不重疊；Ph2為研究者發起、單一地區（日本）、樣本中等，Ph3驗證結果尚待公布。

en.tag: Newly added via active discovery · Ph3 recruiting
en.body: Active pipeline discovery surfaced a previously untracked pivotal-stage asset: MSA-01 (ubiquinol / reduced coenzyme Q10), developed by the University of Tokyo (Jun Mitsui) with Nobelpharma. Its Phase 2 trial (UMIN000031771) was published in EClinicalMedicine in 2023: 139 patients, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, with a least-squares mean difference of −1.7 points (95% CI −3.2 to −0.2, p=0.023) in UMSARS Part 2 change from baseline at week 48, meeting the primary endpoint. Building on this result, a pivotal Ph3 trial (NCT07446894) started recruiting on 2026/02/09, with an estimated enrollment of 140 across 12 Japanese sites and an estimated primary completion in 2028/03. The registration had gone over 7 months without an update and fell outside CT.gov's recent-sort top-40 scan window, so it was missed in routine scans until surfaced here through a broader pipeline search.
en.note: → The mechanism — nutritional supplementation addressing a CoQ10 biosynthesis deficiency (COQ2-related) — does not overlap with the alpha-synuclein-, neuroinflammation- or cell-therapy-centered assets otherwise tracked on this site. The Ph2 trial was investigator-initiated, single-region (Japan), with a moderate sample size; Ph3 confirmatory results are still pending.

tag: 學會發表 · 試驗讀出
body: Alterity 於 MDS 2026 國際大會（首爾）發表 ATH434-201 Ph2 新分析：以基線腦脊髓液 NfL 為共變項調整後，ATH434 50mg 組第52週 modified UMSARS Part I 相對安慰劑之減緩幅度由原頂線 48% 擴大為約 52%（差異 −4.64 分，p=0.032）；吞嚥量表（SDQ）52週變化亦呈顯著差異（50mg 惡化 1.2 分 vs 安慰劑 8.5 分，p=0.003）；QSM 鐵造影見殼核／蒼白球鐵沉積減少趨勢。分析族群為 mITT 61人。
note: → 屬 2025/01 頂線數據之事後生物標記調整分析，非新試驗、未經同儕審查，樣本仍小，詳見 競品試驗結果。

en.body: At the MDS 2026 International Congress (Seoul), Alterity presented a new analysis of the ATH434-201 Ph2 trial: after adjusting for baseline CSF NfL as a covariate, the week-52 slowing on modified UMSARS Part I for the ATH434 50mg arm versus placebo widened from the original 48% topline to roughly 52% (−4.64 points, p=0.032); the swallowing scale (SDQ) also showed a significant week-52 difference (50mg worsened 1.2 points vs 8.5 on placebo, p=0.003); QSM iron imaging showed a trend of reduced iron in the putamen and globus pallidus. The analysis population was a modified ITT of 61.
en.note: → A post-hoc biomarker-adjusted analysis of the 2025/01 topline data, not a new trial, not yet peer-reviewed, and still a small sample — see Competitive Trial Results.

body: Lundbeck 公告將於 MDS 2026 國際大會（首爾，2026/10/04–08）發表旗下動作障礙藥物線多項資料，MSA 相關部分包括：①樞紐 Ph3 MASCOT 試驗（amlenetug／Lu AF82422，NCT06706622）收案人群多樣性之基線特徵（Late-breaking oral，10/5），確認收案 401 人、涵蓋 MSA-C 與 MSA-P 兩亞型，72 週雙盲安慰劑對照、主要讀出預計 2027 Q3；②mUMSARS Part I 量表之心理計量驗證、及其中文版驗證（ePoster 149／150，10/5）；③以質譜蛋白體學尋找候選腦脊髓液生物標記（ePoster 121），及一項以 C 端 α-突觸核蛋白檢測區分 MSA 與帕金森氏症之口頭報告（OPP3-G）；④一項美國健保資料庫觀察性研究，發現 MSA 病人之醫療資源使用與支出顯著高於帕金森氏症病人。
note: → 本次公告為研討會議程預告，非試驗結果讀出：MASCOT 的基線多樣性描述不含任何療效或安全性數據；amlenetug 的主要療效結果仍待 2027 Q3。生物標記與量表驗證項目目前僅公告將發表，具體數值待會議現場公布後再補。

en.body: Lundbeck announced it will present multiple movement-disorder pipeline updates at the MDS 2026 International Congress (Seoul, 2026/10/04–08). The MSA-related items include: (1) baseline characteristics describing participant diversity in the pivotal Phase III MASCOT trial (amlenetug / Lu AF82422, NCT06706622) (late-breaking oral, 10/5), confirming 401 participants enrolled, spanning both the MSA-C and MSA-P subtypes, in a 72-week double-blind, placebo-controlled design with the primary readout expected in Q3 2027; (2) psychometric validation of the modified UMSARS Part I scale and of its Chinese-language version (ePosters 149/150, 10/5); (3) candidate cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers identified via mass-spectrometry proteomics (ePoster 121), plus an oral presentation on a C-terminal alpha-synuclein assay to differentiate MSA from Parkinson's disease (OPP3-G); (4) a US claims-database observational study finding significantly higher healthcare resource use and costs among MSA patients compared with Parkinson's disease patients.
en.note: → This announcement is a congress-agenda preview, not a trial readout: the MASCOT baseline/diversity description contains no efficacy or safety data, and amlenetug's primary efficacy result remains pending for Q3 2027. The biomarker and scale-validation items are announced only as forthcoming presentations; specific figures will be added once presented at the congress.
